{{Quote|The Empire is on the verge of success. Soon, peace and order will be restored throughout the galaxy. Even now, our capable forces, led by Darth Vader, are striking back at the Rebel insurgents.|Palpatine's speech|<ref name="TIE" />}}
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] made a speech regarding the '''state''' of the war. He had summoned virtually all of his [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]] so he would unveil the future of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], which included several [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], some [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B escort frigates]], and even an [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]]. [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] were also tasked with escorting several [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] to the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] where he made his announcement from the [[Imperial Palace audience chamber/Legends|Audience Chamber]].

==Behind the scenes==
The State of the Galactic Civil War was an event that was shown during the intro to the [[1994]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']].
